reviews.title: Amazing monitor, would buy again.
reviews.comment: Incredible picture quality and latency, I was worried that the 165Hz wouldn’t be enough but it’s amazing for 4k gaming. Coming from a 1080P 144Hz IPS monitor, this monitor makes every game look like the game trailer. Incredibly smooth picture in every game I’ve played including Red Dead 2, GTA V, Arma 3, Kingdom Come Deliverance 2, forza Horizon 5. I’m glad I didn’t spend the extra money for the MSI 31UPX, I only game with the monitor and don’t need a built in KVM switch since I don’t run dual monitors. Also I get more than enough bandwidth out of the DP1.4 for 4k gaming over 165 FPS. I’m running a 9800X3D and RX7900XTX and I couldn’t be happier with this monitor. OLED Pros: - Amazing picture quality, color, and latency - Great price for a major upgrade (sub $800) - 3 year factory burn warranty - You can decide when to do the OLED care to avoid burn in, only takes a few minutes and you can skip it if you’re in the middle of important tasks or games. OLED Cons: - I have to turn up the brightness in some games, the true black on this monitor is TRULY BLACK, if you’re in a dark game you may have to turn up your gamma or your brightness, I think the newer generation OLEDs are slightly brighter but it isn’t bad and actually adds to the intensity of certain games like KCD2 when you’re sneaking around at night. - Controls on the back underside of monitor, I wish they would add a cheap remote so I don’t have to reach underneath to skip the OLED care. I gamed all day on this thing and the OLED care came up twice, it’s very easy to skip or you can just take bathroom/food breaks and let it do its thing when you want. People made the OLED care out to be some kind of major issue and it’s not. (Maybe for MLG guys it might be an issue but if you like semi competitive gaming or story driven games it’s not an issue) - Very short power cable (2.5 Feet long)
reviews.author: Floody Fontana

reviews.title: Msi mag 321up QD OLED 4K review
reviews.comment: This a great monitor it’s a night and day difference between other panels, the colors pop much more vivid than my current 4k mini led monitors. The deep colors make gaming so much more immersive. For me it was between this and the rog 4k oled but that one was much more expensive plus I’ve always liked Msi monitors my first ever gaming monitor was from them they offer some amazing products. This monitor does everything you’ll need although I did wish that it came with built in speakers that would be my only gripe. Easy to assemble very sturdy has a height and tilt adjustable stand that comes in handy. I would be interested in comparing that flat panel to the curved panel as well to compare viewing angles as I feel the flat panels are less flexible. All in all great monitor for a great price would definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Darryl Harris

reviews.title: Stunning visuals and smooth performance for gaming and work
reviews.comment: I’ve been using the MSI MAG 321UP QD-OLED monitor for a few weeks now, and it’s been an absolute joy for both gaming and daily use. The 32-inch 4K display is gorgeous—colors are incredibly vibrant thanks to the QD-OLED technology, with deep blacks and excellent contrast that really make games and movies pop. The sharpness at UHD resolution is perfect for multitasking and creative work too. What really stands out is the 165Hz refresh rate combined with Adaptive Sync. Gameplay is super smooth and responsive, with no noticeable screen tearing or stuttering. Whether I’m playing fast-paced shooters or immersive RPGs, the experience feels fluid and immersive. Setup was straightforward, and the monitor’s design is sleek and modern. It has plenty of connectivity options which make hooking up multiple devices a breeze. If you’re looking for a high-end monitor that delivers stunning picture quality and buttery smooth performance, this MSI QD-OLED is definitely worth considering. It’s a noticeable upgrade from traditional LCDs and really enhances the gaming and viewing experience.
reviews.author: Kyle

reviews.title: "Panel Protect" maintenance feature *always* interrupts my work day.
reviews.comment: This monitor has a "panel protect" feature that makes the monitor unusuable for several minutes for some kind of maintenance task.  I used to use this as a gaming monitor and now I use it at work.  I thought it would run its "panel protect" maintenance at night, but the damn thing keeps interrupting my work with this automatic task that makes it unusable until it's done. I'm writing this now after I literally came back to work from a bathroom break to find that my monitor is unusable. Don't buy this.  I have a second 4K OLED monitor from a different brand that has no such problem. Yes, the display quality is good, but there are much better products available. Not recommended for gaming, office work, or any other purpose.
reviews.author: Vivian River Langdon

reviews.title: Excellent Monitor
reviews.comment: This is an excellent O-LED monitor. Color & pixels are great, and the Refresh Rate is more than enough. When running 4k on games the monitor provides stunning colors and runs smoothly with no screen tearing or artifacts. It works smoothly and is very easy to set up or customize how ever you like. Also the stand it comes with provides plenty of room to move around as needed. The Panel Protect feature does not impede normal use, and if needed can be set to 16 hour intervals instead of 4 hours or done manually. Also came with an 8k DP and 8k HDMI cable which is useful as I have multiple devices to take advantage of the different inputs. This is a great entry level monitor for 4k O-LED with a reasonable refresh rate for games.
